mapper.select: SELECT country.* FROM country_categories country LEFT JOIN country_categories parent ON parent.id = country.parent_id WHERE country.is_visible = 1 AND ( ( country.parent_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM country_categories country_child WHERE country_child.parent_id = country.id AND country_child.code LIKE CONCAT(country.code, '-%') ) ) OR ( country.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND parent.parent_id IS NULL AND country.code NOT LIKE '%-%' ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN country.parent_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, country.region_name ASC
